scientific_integrity: A new asymptotic frequency law for exact strict-crossing indices. Source inequalities used explicitly as premises; finite checks do not certify the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The index formula holds off a zero-density exceptional set, not for all indices.
No effective density convergence rate or complete exceptional-index classification.
Historical priority not independently audited; full texts of some less relevant related earlier work were inaccessible.
title: Optimal reciprocal Lucas crossing indices: a two-point density law
